title: A Contest With Barely Any Rules — Part 2

series.summary: A contest for the right to stand beside Rentaro turns physical, and a towering woman in purple starts throwing grown men into the sky.

segments.voiceover_text: A contest is announced in front of the whole crowd, and the rules are barely rules. The winner gets to stand beside Rentaro.
One woman steps out in purple, arms bare, braid swinging, grinning far too wide. She did not come here to play anything gentle.
She lifts a grown man off the grass and throws him. He spirals up past the clouds until only his red coat is left.
A girlfriend catches that grip and holds it. Hands lock, knuckles whiten, and neither one gives a single inch on the open field.
